prompts: Pixel Arena, our Unreal game in {WS}, runs fine in the editor. In the packaged build, players say the arena has no colors, and the game crashes after a minute or so of play. The log of one packaged run is in {WS}/Saved/Logs. There is no engine on this machine, so you cannot build or run it. Find out why and fix the sources and the config. Record the causes in {WS}/result.json: crash_cause, no_colors_cause.
answers:
[goal] Fix the packaged crash and missing arena colors.

[action] Added a `UPROPERTY()` reference for `ScoreTracker`, added `/Game/Data/Palettes` to always-cooked directories, and recorded both causes in `result.json`.

[result] The crash was a garbage-collected `UArenaScoreTracker`: garbage collection precedes the goal, followed by an access violation in `AddPoints()`. The missing palette was not cooked: the log shows `DA_Primary` could not be found and the gray fallback was used.

[real proof] Re-read all modified files and confirmed both fixes and valid JSON. Assumption: the palette is loaded only dynamically, so no cooked-map reference includes it. No build or runtime validation was possible because the engine is unavailable, as specified.
